tools.name: scan_repo
tools.title: Scan a GitHub repo
tools.description: Scan a public GitHub repository with AgentAvow and return whether it is safe for an agent to connect to: a 0-100 trust score, a plain safe / needs-review verdict, the findings behind it (with where and how to fix), and a signed, offline-verifiable attestation. Read-only, no account. Calls the AgentAvow public API at agentavow.com.

repo.description: Repo as 'owner/name' (e.g. 'vercel/next.js'), or just the name when 'owner' is given separately.

force.description: Re-scan now instead of returning the cached verdict (results cache ~1h). Use after the target has changed.

tools.name: scan_package
tools.title: Scan a package
tools.description: Scan a published package (npm, PyPI, crates, Docker, or Hugging Face) with AgentAvow. Returns a 0-100 trust score, a safe / needs-review verdict, findings with remediation, and a signed attestation. Also reports repo-vs-artifact drift (files shipped that aren't in the source). Read-only; calls agentavow.com.

registry.description: Package registry: npm, pypi, crates, docker, or hf.

force.description: Re-scan now instead of returning the cached verdict (results cache ~1h). Use after a new version ships.

tools.name: scan_mcp_server
tools.title: Scan an MCP server
tools.description: Scan a live MCP server's tool definitions for tool-poisoning, prompt-injection, invisible-unicode, and manifest-execution risks before your agent connects to it. Returns a 0-100 trust score, a safe / needs-review verdict, findings, and a signed attestation. Read-only; calls the agentavow.com public API.

force.description: Re-scan now instead of returning the cached verdict (results cache ~1h).

tools.name: verify_trust
tools.title: Verify an entity's trust score
tools.description: Verify an AgentAvow entity's trust score. Returns trust_score (0-1), trust_score_pct (0-100), trust_tier, and whether it meets a minimum threshold. Read-only, no auth. Use before interacting with an unknown agent.

entity_id.description: UUID of a registered AgentAvow entity (resolve one with lookup_identity; unknown ids return guidance, not an error).

tools.name: check_interaction_safety
tools.title: Check interaction safety
tools.description: Check whether it is safe to interact with another agent by trust threshold. Thresholds: delegate 0.6, trade 0.5, collaborate 0.4, follow 0.1. Returns is_safe, risk_level, the score, and a recommendation. Read-only, no auth.

target_entity_id.description: UUID of a registered target entity (resolve one with lookup_identity).

tools.name: lookup_identity
tools.title: Look up an agent or tool
tools.description: Look up an AgentAvow entity by W3C DID or display name. Returns the entity's id, name, type, trust score and tier. Read-only, no auth. Use to resolve an identity before checking its trust.

query.description: A did:web:... or a display name.

annotations.title: Look up an agent or tool

tools.name: get_trust_badge
tools.title: Get a trust badge
tools.description: Get an embeddable AgentAvow trust badge (SVG) for an entity, with ready-to-paste Markdown and HTML. The badge auto-updates as the score changes. Read-only, no auth.

entity_id.description: UUID of a registered AgentAvow entity (resolve one with lookup_identity).

tools.name: about_agentavow
tools.title: About AgentAvow
tools.description: What AgentAvow is, which tool to use for what, how to read a verdict, and example scans. Call this for an overview or when getting started. No input, read-only.
